# analyzeShardKey and query sampling — concept pack

> Source-anchored research for analyzeShardKey and query sampling. Run status: COMPLETED.

## Vocabulary

Terms this pack was harvested with, grouped by their relation to the concept; counts are units matched / sources. Zero-hit terms are listed under Coverage. On every unit line, `keywords:` names the terms that matched.

- **self**: analyzeShardKey and query sampling (17/2)

## Structure and components

- [statement] Operators can inspect query-sampling progress with $currentOp and inspect captured queries with $listSampledQueries. Inspecting captured command types helps check what the workload sample contains. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/configureQueryAnalyzer.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/listSampledQueries.md

## How it works

- [statement] Representative query sampling can require several days. The mongosh example evaluates keys using seven days of sampled workload, so a short or quiet interval should not be assumed to characterize a full application cycle. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/analyzeShardKey.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.analyzeShardKey.md
- [statement] SERVER-119912 reports that key-characteristic passes scan the supporting index even when sampleSize is small. SERVER-107799 independently explains the deliberate index-scan approach for these metrics. A small sampleSize therefore should not be treated as a guarantee of proportionally small scan cost; confirm behavior on the deployed build. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-29) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-119912 · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-107799

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Atlas Shard Key Advisor documentation specifies five query samples per second, seven-day sample retention, and manual disabling when sampling is no longer needed. Its UI sampling rate cannot be adjusted through Shard Key Advisor. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/shard-key-analyzer/ · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling
- [statement] SERVER-119912 reports index scans proportional to collection size despite a smaller sampleSize for key-characteristic analysis. Treat this as an implementation warning, not proof about every release; the issue names no affected versions or shipped fix. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-29) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-119912 · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] analyzeShardKey accepts a candidate key for an unsharded or sharded collection, or the current key of a sharded collection. It reports metrics rather than performing the sharding change. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/analyzeShardKey.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.analyzeShardKey.md, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/product-overview/features-of-mongodb-7-0

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB introduced analyzeShardKey and configureQueryAnalyzer in 7.0 to support shard-key evaluation; Percona also included these commands in its 7.0 release line, and ApsaraDB documents the analysis workflow for its users. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/analyzeShardKey.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/configureQueryAnalyzer.md, https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/7.0/release_notes/7.0.2-1.html, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/product-overview/features-of-mongodb-7-0
- [statement] Document sampling and query sampling are distinct: sampleRate or sampleSize controls the documents used for key characteristics, while configureQueryAnalyzer collects operations for read/write distribution. Key-characteristic analysis can run without query sampling. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/analyzeShardKey.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/configureQueryAnalyzer.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/shard-key-analyzer/, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/product-overview/features-of-mongodb-7-0
- [statement] Key-characteristic metrics include cardinality, frequency and monotonicity. Read/write distribution metrics describe routing patterns and the hotness of candidate-key ranges; they require sampled application queries. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/analyzeShardKey.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/shard-key-analyzer/
- [statement] analyzeShardKey does not block collection reads or writes. MongoDB and Alibaba recommend secondary or secondaryPreferred read preference to reduce production impact; non-blocking operation does not establish negligible resource consumption. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/analyzeShardKey.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/product-overview/features-of-mongodb-7-0
- [statement] SERVER-107799 records that random document sampling for range boundaries did not always yield the expected representative sample and could interfere with read/write distribution output. This issue concerns boundary construction, distinct from collecting application-query samples. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-08-11) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-107799 · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling
- [statement] Historical engineering work motivating document sampling reported analysis taking hours on collections with hundreds of millions of documents and high-cardinality keys. This is historical evidence of analysis overhead, not a latency forecast for current deployments. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-78265 · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling
- [statement] MongoDB introduced analyzeShardKey in 7.0 for evaluating existing or prospective shard keys; its output separates key characteristics from read/write distribution. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/analyzeShardKey.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/5-changes-you-should-know-in-mongodb-7-0/
- [statement] Routing metrics require sampled operations. A zero or absent distribution result without samples is not evidence that production queries have zero routing cost. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/analyzeShardKey.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling
- [statement] configureQueryAnalyzer enables collection sampling with mode full and samplesPerSecond, and disables it with mode off. Operators can inspect captured operations with $listSampledQueries and monitor sampling through $currentOp. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/configureQueryAnalyzer.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling
- [statement] Sampling consumes storage: MongoDB keeps sampled queries in an internal TTL-indexed collection and expires them according to queryAnalysisSampleExpirationSecs. Disable sampling after collecting sufficient evidence. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/configureQueryAnalyzer.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling
- [statement] MongoDB ties routing-metric quality to workload representativeness and warns that some applications need several days of query sampling; there is no universal adequate collection window. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/analyzeShardKey.md · keywords: analyzeShardKey and query sampling
